children: Oklo agreed to sell up to $1 billion worth of stock in an at-the-market equity offering program.
The nuclear technology company disclosed the offering in a Friday regulatory filing, saying it had entered an equity distribution agreement with a coalition of major banks.
Oklo also said it terminated a prior equity distribution agreement signed in May that featured similar terms.
It sold nearly 18 million shares for proceeds of around $1 billion under that agreement.
Shares in Oklo were down 2.9% to $38.74 in premarket trading on Friday.
